_doc: O mil do Cristiano. Messi combina com o Vozinha; o goleiro defende tudo enquanto o CR7 envelhece. Elenco: cristiano (7 vermelho), vozinha (1 azul), rei (10 Argentina). Cenário reusa o estádio panorâmico do messi-seguranca.

reacoes.desc: SAME Cristiano but clearly OLDER: hair going grey at the temples, slightly thicker midsection still muscular, same red number 7 kit, standing ready to shoot, determined face — still recognizably him, just aged about ten years

SAME Cristiano as a VERY OLD man: white hair, hunched back, thin frail body in the same red number 7 kit now loose on him, standing weakly ready to kick, exhausted face — still the same character, near the end
standing shocked after a save, eyes wide, mouth open, both hands on the head, same red number 7 kit
standing calmly in goal adjusting one goalkeeper glove with the other hand, impassive veteran face, blue kit number 1 — no celebration, just routine
